text: See! The Lord is about to empty the earth and lay it waste;he will twist its surface,and scatter its inhabitants: [AA]
People and priest shall fare alike:servant and master,Maid and mistress,buyer and seller,Lender and borrower,creditor and debtor. [AB]
The earth shall be utterly laid waste, utterly stripped,for the Lord has decreed this word.
The earth mourns and fades,the world languishes and fades;both heaven and earth languish. [AC]
The earth is polluted because of its inhabitants,for they have transgressed laws, violated statutes,broken the ancient covenant. [2] [AD]
Therefore a curse devours the earth,and its inhabitants pay for their guilt;Therefore they who dwell on earth have dwindled,and only a few are left. [AE]
The new wine mourns, the vine languishes,all the merry-hearted groan. [AF]
Stilled are the cheerful timbrels,ended the shouts of the jubilant,stilled the cheerful harp. [AG]
They no longer drink wine and sing;strong brew is bitter to those who drink it. [AH]
Broken down is the city of chaos, [3]every house is shut against entry. [AI]
In the streets they cry out for lack of wine;all joy has grown dim,cheer is exiled from the land. [AJ]
In the city nothing remains but desolation,gates battered into ruins.
For thus it shall be in the midst of the earth,among the peoples,As when an olive tree has been beaten,as with a gleaning when the vintage is done. [AK]
These [4] shall lift up their voice,they shall sing for joy in the majesty of the Lord,they shall shout from the western sea:
"Therefore, in the eastgive glory to the Lord!In the coastlands of the sea,to the name of the Lord, the God of Israel!" [AL]
From the end of the earth we hear songs:"Splendor to the Just One!"But I said, "I am wasted, wasted away.Woe is me! The traitors betray;with treachery have the traitors betrayed! [AM]
Terror, pit, and trapfor you, inhabitant of the earth! [AN]
One who flees at the sound of terrorwill fall into the pit;One who climbs out of the pitwill be caught in the trap.For the windows on high are openand the foundations of the earth shake. [AO]
The earth will burst asunder,the earth will be shaken apart,the earth will be convulsed.
The earth will reel like a drunkard,sway like a hut;Its rebellion will weigh it down;it will fall, never to rise again." [AP]
On that day the Lord will punishthe host of the heavens [5] in the heavens,and the kings of the earth on the earth.
They will be gathered togetherlike prisoners into a pit;They will be shut up in a dungeon,and after many days they will be punished. [AQ]
Then the moon will blushand the sun be ashamed, [AR]For the Lord of hosts will reignon Mount Zion and in Jerusalem,glorious in the sight of the elders. [6] [AS]
